# arin_poc (Resource)

Manage an ARIN role or person point of contact. New POCs are linked to the API key's ARIN Online account. Contact type and first, middle and last names require replacement. This resource owns all email addresses and phone numbers; do not overlap with other writers of those collections. Remove dependent organization and NET associations before destroy. Contact attributes are sensitive in output but remain in Terraform state. Import by POC handle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# New POCs are linked to the account owning ARIN_API_KEY.
resource "arin_poc" "example" {
  contact_type   = "ROLE"
  company_name   = "Example Networks"
  last_name      = "Network Operations"
  country_code   = "US"
  subdivision    = "VA"
  city           = "Chantilly"
  postal_code    = "20151"
  street_address = ["123 Example Street"]
  emails         = ["noc@example.net"]
  phones = [
    { type = "O", number = "+1-202-555-0100" },
  ]
  comments = ["Network operations contact"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contact_type` (String) ROLE or PERSON. Immutable after creation.
- `country_code` (String) Uppercase two-letter country code.
- `emails` (Set of String, Sensitive) Complete collection of email addresses. At least one is required.
- `last_name` (String, Sensitive) Last name for a PERSON, or role name for a ROLE. Immutable after creation.
- `phones` (Attributes Set, Sensitive) Complete phone collection. At least one office phone is required; each type/number pair must be unique. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phones))
- `street_address` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered address lines. At least one is required.

### Optional

- `city` (String, Sensitive) City. Omission sends an empty value.
- `comments` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered operational comments. Omission clears comments.
- `company_name` (String, Sensitive) Company name. Required for ROLE contacts.
- `first_name` (String, Sensitive) First name. Required for PERSON and empty for ROLE contacts. Immutable after creation.
- `middle_name` (String, Sensitive) Middle name. Immutable after creation.
- `postal_code` (String, Sensitive) Postal code. Required for US and CA contacts.
- `subdivision` (String, Sensitive) State/province code. Required for US and CA contacts.

### Read-Only

- `country_calling_code` (String) E.164 country calling code returned by ARIN, retained as text.
- `country_code3` (String) Three-letter country code returned by ARIN.
- `country_name` (String) Country name returned by ARIN.
- `id` (String) ARIN-generated POC handle.
- `registration_date` (String) Server-generated registration date, preserved on update.

<a id="nestedatt--phones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phones`

Required:

- `number` (String) Phone number, including international dialing prefix, for example +1-202-555-0100.
- `type` (String) O (office), F (fax), or M (mobile).

Optional:

- `extension` (String, Sensitive) Phone extension. Omission clears it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arin_poc.example EXAMPLE-ARIN
```
